about: PickleballRecs starter catalog. Every value was read on the linked maker page (or, where noted, Pickleball Central) on the checked date and approved by the owner on 2026-10-19. Blank = not published. Products sold in several shapes are one entry per shape. Model year = maker's wording/URL, otherwise the year the maker's shop listed the product; Franklin gives none, 2025 used with the owner's OK. Swing weight is on each maker's own scale. Columns: core = core thickness, balance = swing weight. Expansion (owner chose current + popular brands, 2026-10-20): 2024–2026 performance paddles from the brands above plus Vatic Pro, Gearbox, Proton, Bread & Butter, 11SIX24, Volair, Diadem, ProKennex, Holbrook and Ronbus; colour, signature, limited, demo and blemished listings merged or left out, beginner/budget models left out. Model year = the year the maker shop first listed the product. Expansion rows record shape and core thickness only where the product title states them; their other columns are blank because they were not recorded, not because they are unpublished. Batch 2 (owner asked for the brands r/Pickleball discusses most, 2026-10-20): Spartus, RPM, Luzz, Pakle, Pickleball Apes, FLiK, Neonic, Enhance, Helios and Pickle Poppers, plus Engage Axiom and the older but still popular Vatic Pro Prism (2023); same rules as the expansion.
